tickets.title: Prepare sale-liquidity staging plan
tickets.text: Prepare a plan showing how incoming business-sale cash could be separated among immediate household reserves, estimated tax reserves, renovation funds, debt decisions, and staged investment tranches for Julian and Priya Maplesprocket.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the sale-liquidity staging plan by 2025-01-08.

tickets.title: Prepare preferred-equity rollover review
tickets.text: Prepare a plain-language financial review of the proposed $1.5 million rollover into Copper Firefly Systems preferred equity, including liquidity limits, dividend terms, redemption rights, and concentration risk.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare that preferred-equity rollover review by 2025-01-10.

tickets.title: Prepare CPA sale-tax projection package
tickets.text: Prepare a coordinated tax estimate covering federal, Oregon, basis, installment-payment assumptions, escrow taxation, and the shareholder note treatment before Julian makes large cash-allocation decisions.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the CPA sale-tax projection package by 2025-01-07.

tickets.title: Model shareholder note payoff treatment
tickets.text: Model the $380,000 shareholder note payoff treatment separately from equity proceeds so the advisory team and CPA can distinguish repayment cash from taxable sale consideration assumptions.
tickets.evidence: Julian asked for the sale model to show the $380,000 shareholder note separately from equity proceeds so the advisory team and CPA can distinguish repayment cash from taxable sale consideration assumptions; the agreed follow-up is to model the shareholder note payoff treatment by 2025-01-08.

tickets.title: Prepare escrow holdback reserve analysis
tickets.text: Prepare a separate reserve scenario that excludes escrow release proceeds for the liquidity plan, given the buyer’s schedule and board materials show different figures for the employee retention bonus pool and Julian may not receive the full escrowed amount for an extended period.
tickets.evidence: Review of the draft transaction terms showed that Julian may not receive the full escrowed amount for an extended period, so the liquidity plan needs a separate reserve scenario that excludes escrow release proceeds;

tickets.title: Verify incoming-wire capacity and receiving instructions
tickets.text: Verify the receiving-bank process for expected sale proceeds at Teacup Comet Bank, including incoming-wire capacity and receiving instructions, before funds are sent.
tickets.evidence: Julian reported that Teacup Comet Bank previously held a large inbound wire for manual review, so the receiving-bank process for expected sale proceeds needs verification before funds are sent. The agreed follow-up is to verify incoming-wire capacity and receiving instructions by 2025-01-02.

tickets.title: Prepare post-sale investment policy
tickets.text: Prepare a written allocation framework reflecting staged deployment, cash comfort, tax exposure, and fossil-fuel screening preferences for the household’s post-sale investment portfolio.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the post-sale investment policy by 2025-01-22.

tickets.title: Prepare renovation and mortgage reserve modeling
tickets.text: Model the possible Portland renovation (estimated cost $900,000 to $1.2 million), existing mortgage terms, lake-cabin debt, and desired liquidity floor before deciding how much sale cash can be committed to property spending.
tickets.evidence: Their possible Portland renovation, existing mortgage terms, lake-cabin debt, and desired liquidity floor need to be modeled before deciding how much sale cash can be committed to property spending; the agreed follow-up is to prepare renovation and mortgage reserve modeling by 2025-01-16.
